title: Uncle's trade at home and Bunk Johnson at his rehearsals
summary: His uncle made cigars at the family shop at 1726 North Villere; Bunk Johnson came to rehearsals at his house, where Bigard watched as a boy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
